description: This file contains a set of shell functions for testing and verifying the integrity and consistency of multi-pack indexes (midx) in a Git repository. It defines functions to check midx consistency, compute checksums, compare Git modes, and validate results using test assertions.

methods.name: test_midx_consistent
methods.description: Checks the consistency of the multi-pack index in the given directory by listing index files, reading the index, comparing expected and actual outputs, and verifying the index with Git's multi-pack-index verify command.

methods.name: midx_checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum of the multi-pack index in the specified object directory.

methods.name: midx_git_two_modes
methods.description: Compares the behavior of Git commands with multiPackIndex disabled and enabled, optionally sorting the outputs for comparison.

methods.name: compare_results_with_midx
methods.description: Runs a series of Git commands in different modes and checks their outputs for success, ensuring that Git operations are consistent with the midx configuration.
